author: Athul Prem
scope: Finite-discrete SAFE lead diagnostic at one frequency. No device scattering was solved. The indicators do not bound full-device error or establish continuum channel completeness.
interpretation: The 8 by 4 section is a bounded numerical reference. The final width increment at z4 and the 2-to-4 thickness increment at width8 are below 0.01 rad over 1.8 micrometres. The last separate 3-to-4 thickness comparison is at width4. No continuum extrapolation is claimed.
complex_encoding: [real, imaginary]. Each propagating displacement array is ordered [component, scalar section DOF, mode, complex pair]. Negative fields are conjugate references only where raw equality was verified exactly. Full displacements and dual axial forces for both signs remain in the raw checkpoints.
